meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein agar aapki skin acne-prone hai (yaani pimples aur daag-dhabbe jaldi ho jaate hain), toh **700 rupees ke andar** kuch best aur dermatologist-tested serums available hain.

Sahi serum choose karna is baat par depend karta hai ki aapko **active acne (chal rahe pimples)** theek karne hain ya phir **purane daag-dhabbe (acne marks)** hatane hain:

---

### 1. Agar Active Pimples aur Clogged Pores hain:

* **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum[www.dermatocare.com](https://www.dermatocare.com/bha-or-salicylic-acid-use-benefits-and-side-effects-dermatologist-guide/#:~:text=10%20Best%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Serums%20in%20India,Pilgrim.%20Pilgrim%202%25%20Salicylic%20Acid%20Face%20Serum.)** *(Price: Approx. ₹499)*[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/serums/serums-essence/c/8397#:~:text=The%20Ordinary.%20Niacinamide%2010%25%20%2B%20Zinc%201%25,Sizes.%20%E2%82%B9499%E2%82%B942914%25%20Off.%20Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B969.)
  *   * **Kyu kharidein:** Salicylic Acid ek BHA hai jo pores ke andar jaakar oil aur dirt ko saaf karta hai. Yeh active pimples, blackheads aur whiteheads ke liye sabse best hai.
* **The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Serum[www.dermatocare.com](https://www.dermatocare.com/bha-or-salicylic-acid-use-benefits-and-side-effects-dermatologist-guide/#:~:text=The%20Derma%20Co%20Sali-Cinamide%20Anti-Acne%20Serum%20with,Uneven%20dull%20skin%2C%20Red%20pimples%2C%20and%20Blackheads%2FPores.)** *(Price: Approx. ₹300–₹499)*
  *   * **Kyu kharidein:** Isme **Salicylic Acid aur Niacinamide** ka combination milta hai. Yeh ek hi waqt par active acne ko theek karta hai aur oil production ko control karta hai.

### 2. Agar Redness, Oil Control aur Light Marks ke liye chahiye (Beginner-Friendly):

* **Minimalist 5% ya 10% Niacinamide Face Serum[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/serums/serums-essence/c/8397#:~:text=Minimalist.%20Niacinamide%2005%25%20Face%20Serum.%20%E2%82%B9599%E2%82%B95695%25%20Off.,Gallic%20AOX%20Barrier%20Repair%2C%20Plumper%2C%20Even%20Skin.)** *(Price: ₹499 - ₹599)*[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/serums/serums-essence/c/8397#:~:text=%2823%29%20Minimalist.%2010%25%20Niacinamide%20Face%20Serum%20With,2%20Sizes.%20%E2%82%B9599%E2%82%B949717%25%20Off.%20Extra%2010%25%20Off.)
  *   * **Kyu kharidein:** Agar aapki skin sensitive hai aur naye pimples ke sath redness rehti hai, toh Niacinamide skin barrier ko strong banata hai, extra oil control karta hai, aur halka-fulka glow deta hai.
* **The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%[aryeva.com](https://aryeva.com/best-niacinamide-serum-india/#:~:text=Put%20this%20next%20to%20The%20Ordinary's%20Niacinamide,salts%2C%20acetyl%20glucosamine%20and%20a%20marine%20ferment.)** *(Price: Approx. ₹600)*[www.nykaa.com](https://www.nykaa.com/skin/serums/serums-essence/c/8397#:~:text=The%20Ordinary.%20Niacinamide%2010%25%20%2B%20Zinc%201%25,Sizes.%20%E2%82%B9499%E2%82%B942914%25%20Off.%20Price%20dropped%20by%20%E2%82%B969.)
  *   * **Kyu kharidein:** Yeh oily aur blemish-prone skin ke liye iconic serum hai. Isme Zinced formula hota hai jo excess sebum (oil) ko rokkta hai.

### 3. Agar Sirf Purane Kaale Daag-Dhabbe (Pigmentation) hatane hain:

* **Deconstruct Dark Spot Clearing Serum[www.aliteskincare.in](https://www.aliteskincare.in/blogs/skin-care/best-niacinamide-serums-in-india-for-every-budget#:~:text=1.%20Minimalist%20Niacinamide%205%25%20Face%20Serum-30ml%20%28%E2%82%B9599%29,Deconstruct%20Dark%20Spot%20Clearing%20Serum%20-30ml%20%28%E2%82%B9699%29)** *(Price: Approx. ₹699)*[www.aliteskincare.in](https://www.aliteskincare.in/blogs/skin-care/best-niacinamide-serums-in-india-for-every-budget#:~:text=Oil-free%20and%20Fragrance%20Free.%20Repairs%20damaged%20skin,Key%20ingredients%3A%2010%25%20Niacinamide.%201%25%20Zinc%20PCA.)
  *   * **Kyu kharidein:** Isme 5% Niacinamide aur 2% Alpha Arbutin hota hai, jo ziddi se ziddi post-acne marks aur uneven skin tone ko tezi se light karta hai.

---

### 💡 Quick Tip:

* Agar abhi **active pimples** aa rahe hain, toh **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid** ya **The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide** se shuru karein.
* Inhe use karte waqt din mein **Sunscreen** lagana bilkul na bhulein.
